descriptionHtml:
Feature: Activity rankings for a city's next 7 days

As a traveller who has chosen a destination, I want each of the next 7 days to rank Skiing, Surfing, Outdoor Sightseeing and Indoor Sightseeing so that I can plan what to do on which day.

Each day lists all four activities ranked 1 (most suitable) to 4, each with a suitability score from 0 to 100, a rating band, and plain-language reasons the front end can display.

Rule: Invalid requests are rejected with an explanation the front end can show
